questions.question: Who built the Great Pyramids of Giza?
questions.explanation: The Ancient Egyptians built the pyramids over 4,500 years ago as tombs for pharaohs! 🏺

questions.question: Who invented the telephone?
questions.explanation: Alexander Graham Bell made the first telephone call in 1876 — to his assistant Watson! 📞

questions.question: Who was the first person to walk on the Moon?
questions.explanation: Neil Armstrong stepped on the Moon on 20 July 1969 saying 'One small step for man...' 🚀

questions.question: Which ancient wonder was located in Egypt?
questions.explanation: The Lighthouse of Alexandria was one of the 7 Wonders of the Ancient World! 🗼

questions.question: Who painted the Mona Lisa?
questions.explanation: Da Vinci painted the Mona Lisa between 1503-1519 — it's now in the Louvre in Paris! 🎨

questions.question: When did India gain independence?
questions.explanation: India gained independence from British rule on 15 August 1947 — Independence Day! 🇮🇳

questions.question: Who was the first woman to win a Nobel Prize?
questions.explanation: Marie Curie won Nobel Prizes in both Physics (1903) and Chemistry (1911)! ⚗️
